title: 🚿 Sculpted in the Rain 🌊
scripts:
[0:00-0:04] He shifts his weight onto his left leg, causing a slight tilt in his hips, and begins to lift his right arm toward his face.
[0:04-0:008] As he wipes water from his forehead with his right hand, his bicep and shoulder tighten; he uses his left hand to pull the black cloth slightly upward against his waist, creating a subtle tension in his core.
[0:08-0:10] He settles into a centered, frontal pose, looking directly into the lens with a heavy-lidded, steady gaze.
The camera stays completely fixed — no pan, tilt, or zoom. Quiet outdoor shower ambient tone only — the steady splash of water against skin and concrete. No voices, speech, dialogue, chatter, distant talking, echoes of people, crowd, footsteps, or music.

[0:00-0:04] From the centered position, he draws his elbows back and away from his sides, initiating a powerful, slow lat spread.
[0:04-0:08] The lats widen and the chest muscles expand under the falling water; he holds this broad, muscular pose as the light rakes across the wet, glistening skin.
[0:08-0:10] He brings his arms back down to his sides, settling into a stable, frontal position with eyes fixed directly on the camera.
The camera stays completely fixed — no pan, tilt, or zoom. Quiet outdoor shower ambient tone only — the steady splash of water against skin and concrete. No voices, speech, dialogue, chatter, distant talking, echoes of people, crowd, footsteps, or music.

[0:00-0:04] He slowly raises his right hand, fingers brushing against his wet collarbone as he begins a slow, deliberate descent toward the center of his chest.
[0:04-0:08] The hand continues tracing down over his pectorals, causing the muscles to subtly tense; he arches his torso slightly to catch the light on his abdomen.
[0:08-0:10] He lets the hand drop to rest near his waist and settles into a final, still pose, looking directly at the lens with an intense, heavy-lidded hold.
The camera stays completely fixed — no pan, tilt, or zoom. Quiet outdoor shower ambient tone only — the steady splash of water against skin and concrete. No voices, speech, dialogue, chatter, distant talking, echoes of people, crowd, footsteps, or music.
